title: Sniper bot at the open
attempt: A bot bids as soon as the window opens, hoping to buy at a better price.
outcome: Every winner pays the clearing price. In nosnipe-11140458 the first and last bidders each paid 0.002 USDC per token.

title: Copied ciphertext
attempt: A bidder submits a copy of another account’s sealed bid.
outcome: The enclave detects the account mismatch when it opens the bid. In a settled sale the contract voids the bid and returns the deposit less a 1% penalty.

title: Wrong ciphertext size
attempt: A bidder sends a sealed bid with the wrong length.
outcome: The contract refuses the bid at intake, records the rejection, and returns the full deposit.

title: Closing the sale early
attempt: Someone tries to close the sale while the bid window is open.
outcome: The contract rejects the call and leaves the bid window open until the scheduled deadline.

title: Claiming twice
attempt: A bidder requests the same token allocation or refund again.
outcome: The contract marks each payout before sending it. A duplicate claim returns false and sends no second transfer.

title: Chapters reveal with a wrong salt
attempt: A holder tries to reveal with a salt that differs from the original vote.
outcome: The contract rejects the reveal because it fails the commitment check and leaves the tally unchanged.

title: Chapters double vote
attempt: A holder attempts to lock more tokens for a second vote in the same round.
outcome: The contract keeps the original vote, returns the duplicate transfer in full, and counts the holder’s weight once.

title: Chapters withdrawal before the round ends
attempt: A holder tries to withdraw their voting tokens while the round is still running.
outcome: The contract rejects the withdrawal and keeps the lock claimable after the round is finalized.
